title: UFO waves in Dalarna

tellings.quote:
We have in
Sweden Dalana which is in the middle of
Sweden where we have had several waves
of UFO observations.

plain: Dalarna, a region in the middle of Sweden, is said to have had several waves of UFO sightings. A Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn says this on Michels' show, speaking from his own field without citing a particular source. It marks the region as a repeated hotspot for such reports.
